usage: music-tagger candidates [-h] [--artist ARTIST] [--album ALBUM]
                               [--barcode BARCODE] [-o OUT | --json]
                               path

Read album, search MusicBrainz, and score candidates.

positional arguments:
  path               Album directory.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --artist ARTIST    Override artist name (for freshly ripped files).
  --album ALBUM      Override album title (for freshly ripped files).
  --barcode BARCODE  Filter results by barcode (UPC/EAN).
  -o, --out OUT      Also write the full results as JSON to this file.
  --json             Print JSON to stdout instead of the table.
